newsitem.title: NORWAY: Kvaerner associate wins NOK 600 mln deal.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner associate wins NOK 600 mln deal.

text.p: Norwegian industrial group Kvaerner ASA said on Wednesday that Gammon Construction, an associate company based in Hong Kong, had won a contract worth nearly NOK 600 million for constructing an office building in Hong Kong.

Known as Oxford House, the 39-storey development will have a four-level basement and a link bridge adjacent to Somerset House and will be built by the top-down construction method, a Kvaerner statement said.
It said the contract was let by Swire Properties Limited's subsidiary Cathay Limited and marked the latest stage in Gammon's continuing involvement with the TaiKoo Place development.
Work was due to start immediately with completion scheduled for January 1999.
